message.content: {"predictors": [{"name": "Insider Net Buying Ratio", "construction": "Sum of all insider (officers and directors) open-market share purchases over the past 12 months minus insider sales, divided by total shares outstanding.", "rationale": "Insiders may have superior information on firm prospects; net buyers may signal undervaluation or impending positive developments.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Patent Intensity", "construction": "Number of new US patents granted to the firm in the previous year divided by total assets at fiscal year-end.", "rationale": "Firms with high rates of innovation may be better positioned for future growth and profitability.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Voluntary Disclosure Frequency", "construction": "Count of press releases related to new products, earnings guidance, or strategy (excluding mandatory SEC filings) issued by the firm over the prior 12 months.", "rationale": "Frequent voluntary disclosures may signal management confidence and transparency, attracting investor interest.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Employee Efficiency Ratio", "construction": "Total revenue over the past fiscal year divided by the number of employees (from 10-K filings).", "rationale": "Firms generating more revenue per employee may be more operationally efficient and profitable.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Short-Term Asset Growth", "construction": "Percentage change in cash and short-term investments over the past fiscal year.", "rationale": "Rapid growth in liquid assets may reflect asset redeployment or underutilization, potentially predicting lower future returns if not matched by investment.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Dividend Initiation Indicator", "construction": "Binary variable set to 1 if a firm initiates a regular cash dividend within the last 12 months, 0 otherwise.", "rationale": "The decision to begin paying dividends may signal management’s confidence in sustainable earnings.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "Customer Concentration Risk", "construction": "Percentage of total sales accounted for by the largest single customer, as disclosed in 10-K filings.", "rationale": "Firms highly dependent on a single customer may face greater earnings risk and discounting by investors.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Deferred Tax Asset Ratio", "construction": "Deferred tax assets divided by total assets at fiscal year-end.", "rationale": "Large deferred tax assets may indicate aggressive accounting or expectations of future losses, which could foreshadow poorer performance.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}, {"name": "Earnings Announcement Drift Sensitivity", "construction": "Stock’s average abnormal return over 3-day windows around the past four quarterly earnings announcements.", "rationale": "Stocks that strongly react to earnings surprises may have more persistent mispricing or information inefficiency.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}, {"name": "R&D-to-Sales Change", "construction": "Year-over-year change in R&D expense divided by prior year total sales.", "rationale": "Increasing R&D intensity may indicate management commitment to innovation and future growth.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}]}
